entries.en: to break apart; to tear or pull open
entries.notes: L 栏拼写讹乱（quebrande ha giendo），R 栏残；据 H「拆」与 M「tia」定。

entries.en: for a water channel or pipe to break and leak
entries.notes: H「渇」与水渠义不合，疑形近致误；R 栏空。

entries.en: to break by throwing down; to smash to pieces
entries.notes: M 栏多段重出、部分音写难辨，H「捯」非常用字形。

entries.en: to break or snap (a cord, rope)
entries.notes: M 栏有残缺，R 栏西文夹杂讹写。

entries.en: to pull open; to part with the hands
entries.notes: M、R 两栏皆空，仅据 L 与 H「披開」判定。

entries.en: to snap or break by pinching with the fingers
to crack (nuts) with the teeth
to break by a blow; to smash
to smash to pieces
to break with a heavy blow
entries.notes: M 栏 fia chy 与 H「打拆」对音不整，以 L「porrazo（重击）」为准。

entries.en: to break open by pulling apart, as bread
to smash by hurling down
entries.notes: M 栏末音节重出，音写存疑。

entries.en: to break one's word
to say the wrong thing; to break one's word
to wrinkle the forehead; to knit one's brows
to break off a friendship
entries.notes: H 首字残疑（徐/除），L 义明确。

entries.zh: 绝交、断绝往来（改易旧日来往之路）
entries.en: to break off a friendship by forsaking the former path

entries.zh: （井中汲水的陶罐）破裂，无法取出
entries.en: for the well's water jar to break so that it cannot be drawn up
entries.notes: H 首字残缺、M 音写难辨（sor m chur），仅据 L 大意。

entries.en: a broken thing; a damaged object
for a ship to break up; to be wrecked
to be broken up by medicine (of an ailment)
entries.notes: H 首字残疑（砧/珆），L 语义隐晦，难定夺。
